name: kiobridge-simulation-kit
description: KioBridge Simulation Platform v5 — Canonical Input Contract + digital-twin kiosk simulator (SIMULATION_ONLY, no real device).

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @kiobridge/simulator-web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:public && npm run build
scripts.package:public: npm run release:verify && node tools/build-public-package.mjs && npm run verify:public-package && npm run verify:package-source-parity
scripts.verify:public: npm run release:verify && npm run verify:public-package
scripts.release:verify: npm run sync:contracts && npm run check:contract-drift && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:public && npm run verify:environment-data && npm run verify:compatibility-rules && npm run verify:review-mappings && npm run verify:execution-choice-rules && npm run verify:vocabulary-membership && npm run verify:public-environment-api && npm run verify:review-item-labels && npm run verify:canonical-timestamps && npm run verify:api-examples && npm run verify:participant-ux-guidance && npm run verify:participant-auth-privacy-copy && npm run verify:participant-onboarding && npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:scripts && npm run verify:windows && npm run verify:windows-checklist && npm run verify:e2e-references && npm run verify:package-source-parity -- --phase pre-build && npm run verify:release-chain && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.package:participant: npm run release:verify && KIO_EDITION=participant node tools/build-public-package.mjs && KIO_EDITION=participant npm run verify:public-package
